Description: Make conventional generators committable, with start-up costs and minimum up and down times from the plant data. Solved as a linear relaxation when ``solving: options: linearized_unit_commitment`` is true.
Give plants flagged as must-run in the WECC ADS data a minimum loading (``p_min_pu``) from their minimum load.
Use time-varying historical fuel prices for existing conventional generators instead of the annual AEO and ATB prices.
Use plant-level monthly fuel costs from PUDL. Only read when ``enable`` is true.
Use state and balancing-area prices for gas and coal plants; needs an EIA API key. Only read when ``enable`` is true.
Reserved for ambient-temperature capacity derates of thermal units. Not implemented: setting it to true raises ``NotImplementedError``.
The ambient derate is meant to replace the EIA-860 seasonal derate, never to stack on it (reserved).
